description: This PHP source file handles rescheduling a call within the SuiteCRM system. It processes user input to update the start and end times of a call, and records rescheduling reasons.

classes.name: Calls_Reschedule
classes.description: Represents a record of a call rescheduling, including reason and call ID.

classes.name: Call
classes.description: Represents a call record with start and end dates, duration, and related database operations.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: Handles time and date formatting and merging operations specific to the user's preferences.

methods.name: get_user_time_format
methods.description: Retrieves the logged-in user's preferred time format.

methods.name: merge_time_meridiem
methods.description: Merges time with meridiem indicator (AM/PM) based on user preference.

methods.name: get_time_format
methods.description: Returns the global or system time format.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches a call record by ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current call or reschedule record to the database.
